algorithm_doc: ast-body-v1: per collectable test function (test* functions and test* methods of Test* classes), SHA-256 of ast.dump(include_attributes=False) of the body with a leading docstring removed, first 16 hex characters. Literals and names are kept; comments, formatting and docstrings are ignored. Limitation: the hash ignores decorators (marks, parametrize values), signature and fixture definitions, class context (bases, setup, autouse fixtures) and module-level bindings, so equal hashes prove equal body text, not equal behavior. duplicate_bodies maps file -> tests whose body equals the body of at least one other test; duplicate_names maps file -> class-qualified tests whose Class::name also exists in another file. A test outside these lists that becomes a duplicate fails, except a baselined test moved to another file under the same name; entries may only be removed or re-keyed by such a move.
